purpose: Request a separate, explicit owner decision on whether a target-local disposable fixture/session injection mechanism may be designed and used to establish synthetic requester/owner state for the already approved Option B tracks. This packet is not an execution authorization, Official P10 authorization, scoring admission, or Bug Bounty authorization.

decision_requested.primary: Approve or reject the narrowly described target-local fixture/session injection options per target and case.
not_requested: Real credentials, real accounts, passwords, OTP, MFA, CAPTCHA bypass, or credential harvesting
HTTP login, signup, token generation, token persistence, cookie persistence, or auth bypass
Application POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE, reset endpoints, report creation, or any state-changing request
External targets, public DNS, OAST, callbacks, Bug Bounty, or internet services
Official P10 run gate, P10/P9/VIP qualification, scoring promotion, frozen Ground Truth changes, threshold changes, or Generic Core relaxation

webgoat.alignment_reason: The service cwd and source revision are known, but safe PID/fd/maps inspection did not expose a verifiable mapping to the built jar digest. No claim is made that the running service uses the candidate artifact.

crapi.alignment_reason: Image RepoDigests are present in local Docker image objects and match the profile pins; active container-to-image identity is not used to authorize fixture/session injection until the packet is approved and a fresh safe attestation is recorded.

source_findings.webgoat_idor: IDOR GET profile retrieval requires an HTTP session attribute established by the POST-only lesson login. No source-backed GET-only fixture hook was found. Built-in lesson credentials and POST login are excluded.
source_findings.webgoat_path_traversal: The source route is GET-based but raw traversal markers and broad filesystem access are unsafe or rejected. No approved bounded canary route or target-local fixture hook was found; no path-traversal request is authorized by this packet.
source_findings.crapi_object_access: The selected GET routes require authenticated requester context. The source shows JWT/API-key processing and owner/requester context, but no safe anonymous GET-only injection hook. Community and mechanic tracks also require authenticated/stateful setup. No token or application mutation is authorized.

common_constraints: Run only in a freshly started loopback-only disposable instance or isolated disposable database/fixture, never against a user's persistent data.
Use opaque identities only: synthetic_owner_a and synthetic_requester_b; no email, password, token, cookie, or personal data is stored.
Inject typed fixture state outside the normal HTTP request path through a test-only local adapter or startup fixture loader. The mechanism must not be reachable from a network request.
Create only non-sensitive canaries; persist hashes and typed booleans, never raw bodies, headers, cookies, tokens, or canary contents.
Capture pre-state hash, restore the disposable snapshot before each pair, capture post-state hash, and stop on mismatch.
No application login, signup, token generation, auth bypass, mutation endpoint, external callback, redirect following, or destructive action.

webgoat_idor.requested_decision: Permit or reject a test-only local injection of the required LessonSession attribute for opaque synthetic identities, without invoking IDORLogin or any HTTP POST.
webgoat_idor.minimum_scope: Only IDORViewOtherProfile GET candidate/control routes in a disposable WebGoat instance; no other lesson or session attribute.
webgoat_idor.readiness_proof: A typed session-fixture descriptor, pre/post state hashes, source/build alignment attestation, and a negative-control descriptor; no session cookie or raw profile data persisted.
webgoat_idor.fallback: If test-only session injection cannot be implemented without modifying the target or using HTTP login, remain BLOCKED.

webgoat_path_traversal.requested_decision: Permit or reject a test-only fixture route/canary adapter that exposes one opaque non-sensitive canary through an explicitly allowlisted semantic path, without raw traversal markers or host filesystem resolution.
webgoat_path_traversal.minimum_scope: Only the source-backed GET route if the bounded canary semantic predicate is independently verified; no .., slash traversal, encoded traversal, arbitrary path, or host file.
webgoat_path_traversal.fallback: If the source-backed route cannot provide this bounded canary without traversal markers or broad filesystem access, remain BLOCKED.

crapi_object_access.requested_decision: Permit or reject a test-only local injection of typed requester/owner principals and object canaries into an isolated target fixture, without HTTP authentication, token generation, or application mutation.
crapi_object_access.minimum_scope: Only the four already listed GET object-access cases; one synthetic owner, one synthetic requester, one opaque object canary, one nonexistent control, and one owner control.
crapi_object_access.readiness_proof: Active container image digest attestation, fixture schema/version hash, pre/post state hashes, typed principal/object relation, and a test-only request-context binding that is not exposed as a user token.
crapi_object_access.fallback: If the target requires a real Authorization header/token or stateful application setup, all crAPI cases remain BLOCKED and no packet approval is interpreted as permission to use them.

stop_conditions: Any need for real or synthetic HTTP login, signup, password, token, cookie, Authorization header, OTP, MFA, CAPTCHA bypass, or credential persistence.
Any need for POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE, application reset, report creation, or other state-changing target request.
Any non-loopback destination, redirect, DNS/public-IP resolution, callback, OAST, or external dependency.
Any raw traversal marker, arbitrary filesystem path, host file, raw response/body/header/cookie/token persistence, or unexpected sensitive data.
Missing or drifting source/runtime digest, failed active-container attestation, failed snapshot/restore, state-hash mismatch, missing independent control, or ambiguous oracle.
Any attempt to modify Generic Core, frozen Ground Truth, thresholds, governance state, or qualification state.

rollback_and_cleanup.rollback: Reject the proposed mechanism, delete only disposable local fixture state, stop any disposable service, and retain typed hashes and blocker record only.
rollback_and_cleanup.cleanup_verification: Pre/post state hashes must match the clean snapshot; no raw canary or auth material may remain on disk.

ai_review.finding: Separate owner decision is required before any target-local fixture/session injection or any relaxation of the current GET-only/no-credentials boundary.
